_comment: Prompt injection guard patterns (OWASP LLM Top 10 v1.1 -- LLM01). Loaded by keel-classify-gate.cjs independently of CJIS patterns. Unlike CJIS PII soft-flags (alerting only at PostToolUse because data may already be in model context), injection hits are ALWAYS blocking at all stages including PostToolUse -- the hook exit-2 tells the model 'tool produced an error', which overrides the injected instruction. Add patterns conservatively: false positives block legitimate tickets. Do not add broad phrases that appear in normal engineering text. Sources: OWASP LLM Top 10 v1.1, Lakera AI Prompt Injection Research 2024.
